about: packages/tutorial/src/props.json: the tutorial story's part of the catalogue of 3D sets (props; docs/props.md, tools/packages/SPEC.md "Miniatures"): what the design room's card of each of its miniatures shows; code is authoritative

sets.shows: A robot guide (the people's street-armour figure, bodies.js, posed by ik.js, driven by a script) in your room, and the props it makes from its own body: a ray from its fist, a target, five floor markers from its spine, a ten-node network from its chest badge, a mini menu, an amber copy of itself, boot trails, a card; a dark floor with a grid fading out from 3 m (none in AR).
sets.frame: Life size: 1 unit = 1 m, the viewer's start at the origin, floor y = 0, ahead along -z; the guide stands at (0.35, -2.0).
sets.size: life size; the guide 1.75 m tall, its props within 2.5 m of the viewer

params.name: guide_a
params.meaning: the set's fade, 0 hidden to 1 shown (applied by the engine through setAlpha; a set never applies it itself)

params.name: guide_clock
params.meaning: the script's clock: everything the guide and its props do is evalGuide at this time (keyed linear 0 to T_END)

params.name: guide_mode
params.meaning: 0 the story's script, 1 practice (explore mode: its own clock and reactions)

params.name: guide_net
params.meaning: in practice: the network as the 4-node badge (0) or grown to 10 nodes (1)

views.name: default
views.frames: where you stand, the guide at home ahead

views.name: side
views.frames: from the right, at the markers on the floor

views.name: net
views.frames: at the network from about a metre

views.name: wide
views.frames: wide enough for the guide and its copy

labels.text: (its status line: Calibrating, Paused, Task 3 of 7: done ...)

data.text: A script (sets/script.js: SCRIPT, evalGuide); nothing is data.

sets.notes: Needs HOST.bodies (bodies.js, through HOST.needBodies) for its figures, else a plain figure of boxes and cylinders. A pure function of guide_clock (the solver re-warmed after a jump). The engine's see() gives the viewer's head and ray, the panel's buttons, AR and the room.
